content: Khuavak Sung Nuntakna
Tua ahikom note itna' tate bang in Pathian zui te na hi uh hi;
Christ in hong it a, Pathian tungah ngimnamtui biakpiakna atu in ama le ama a ki piak bang in, itna sungah nungta vun.
Ahihang mithiangtho te na hi zawk uh bangma in paktatna, thiantho ngawlna theampo, a hibale, duhop nate sia note sungah khatvei zong son kul ngawl in om nawn heak tahen;
A lipkhap huai, mawmawt kampauna le ciammuina kammal phangawl te pau heak vun: tua te sang in lungdamna thu son zaw vun.
Banghangziam cile pasal pumpi zuak te, a thiangtho ngawl te, milim bia te a kici a duhop te sia Christ le Pathian kumpingam sungah ngamhlua ngawl tu hi, ci na he uh hi.
Kuama in a mannung ngawl kammal te taw hong theam heak tahen: banghangziam cile hi thu te hang in thuni ngawl tate tungah Pathian thin-ukna theng hi.
Tua ahikom note sia amate taw a ki pawl te na hi heak vun.
Banghangziam cile note sia khatveilai in khuazing na hi ngei uh hi, ahihang tu in note sia Topa sungah khuavak na hi uh hi: tua ahikom khuavak tate bang in nungta vun:
Banghangziam cile Thaa i nga sia na theampo sungah phatna, thutang suana le thuman a hihi;
Topa tungah a san thamman sia bangziam, ci tetti na lak vun.
Taciang bangma phattuamna om ngawl khuazing naseam te taw ki pawlkhopna nei heak vun, ahihang amate tek zaw tavun.
Banghangziam cile amate in kuama heak ngawl in a vawt uh nate a son tu uh zong a mai uh zum hi.
Ahihang tekna theampo te sia khuavak in kilangsak hi: banghangziam cile na theampo a kilangsak sia khuavak a hihi.
Tua ahikom, nang a mutthip pa awng, khanglo in a, thina pan tho in, taciang Christ in khuavak hong pia tu hi, ci hi.
Tua ahikom mi mawmaw te bang hi ngawl in, mipil te bang in kidawm in nungta vun,
Tu hun sia hunphangawl ahikom, hun la in zangthiam vun.
Tua ahikom mawmaw heak vun, ahihang Topa deina a telthiam te hi zaw tavun.
Thaa Taw Kidim Vun
A valkan thei ahi, sapittui na kham heak vun; tuasang in Thaa taw na kidim zaw vun;
Noma le noma Psalm la, pokna la le tha la te taw ki paupui vun, na thinsung uh pan Topa tungah lasa in oai vun;
I Topa Jesus Christ min taw Pa Pathian tungah a tawntung in na theampo atu in lungdamko vun;
Pathian zatakna sungah khat le khat thu ki ni tavun.
Zi te awng, Topa tung na kiap uh bangma in na pasal uh te tungah noma le noma ki ap vun.
Banghangziam cile pasal sia zi i lutang a hihi, tasia bangma in Christ sia pawlpi i lutang a hihi: taciang Ama sia a pumpi tanpa a hihi.
Tua ahikom pawlpi in Christ thu a nit bang in, zi te in na theampo sungah a pasal te thu ni tahen.
Pasal te awng, Christ in pawlpi a it bangma in, na zi te uh it vun, taciang Christ in pawlpi atu in a nuntakna pia hi;
Tabang in Ama in tui taw a sil bang in Pathian thu taw thiangtak in thiangthosak tu ahizong,
Tabang in a minthang pawlpi sia a nin bang ngawl, a hibale a vunton ngawl, a hibale tabang na dang tatuam om ngawl, ahihang a thiangtho le paubang ngawl in Ama tungah a ap thei natu a hihi.
Tua ahikom pasal te in a zi te sia amate pumpi a it bang in a it tu a hihi. A zi a it peuma in ama le ama ki it a hihi.
Banghangziam cile pasal in, ama pumpi ngaimaw ngei ngawl hi; ahihang Topa in pawlpi vak in a khoi bangma in, a zi vak in khoi hi:
Banghangziam cile eite sia Ama pumpi sungah pumpikhen te, a pumpi le a ngu te i hihi.
Hi thu hang in pasal in a pa le a nu nusia tu a, a zi beal tu hi, taciang amate ni sia pumkhat hi tu hi.
Hi thu sia thuku lianpi a hihi: ahihang Christ le pawlpi thu taw kisai in kong son a hihi.
Ahihang note sungah a tuan in khatsim in a zi sia ama le ama a ki it bang in ahizong; taciang a zi in zong a pasal zakta tahen.
